framework: ZYRA VIRGINIA LEGAL INTELLIGENCE COMMAND FRAMEWORK
commandDoctrine: Every material intelligence claim entering the ecosystem must retain provenance, legal status, evidentiary status, corroboration state, and uncertainty. Allegations remain allegations. Adjudicated findings remain adjudicated findings. Analytic judgments remain intelligence analysis.

intelligenceTiers.name: VIRGINIA_PRIMARY_LEGAL_INTELLIGENCE
examples: Supreme Court of Virginia opinion or order
Court of Appeals of Virginia opinion or order
Virginia circuit court order or judgment

intelligenceTiers.name: FEDERAL_LEGAL_INTELLIGENCE_AFFECTING_VIRGINIA
examples: federal court-authorized seizure or disruption record

intelligenceClasses.ADJUDICATED_LEGAL_FACT: A court or legally competent tribunal entered a finding, order, or judgment establishing the proposition for the relevant proceeding.
intelligenceClasses.LEGAL_ACTION_FACT: The evidence establishes that a filing, seizure, publication, sanction, order, or other legal action occurred.
intelligenceClasses.AGENCY_REPORTED_INTELLIGENCE: An agency states that an event, attribution, victimization, or technical condition occurred. Preserve the reporting status unless independently adjudicated or corroborated.
intelligenceClasses.LEGAL_RECORD_ALLEGATION: A complaint, indictment, affidavit, warrant application, or similar legal record alleges conduct that has not been adjudicated.
intelligenceClasses.LEGAL_RECORD_SUMMARY: A source summarizes a legal filing or court record. Preserve both the summary nature and the underlying allegation or finding status.
intelligenceClasses.CORROBORATED_INTELLIGENCE: Two or more independent sufficiently reliable intelligence sources support the proposition without material contradiction.
intelligenceClasses.MEDIA_INTELLIGENCE_CLAIM: A media source reports or quotes a proposition. Use as intelligence context until corroborated.
intelligenceClasses.ANALYTIC_JUDGMENT: A conclusion derived by ZYRA, GPT-DOUG, or GPT-GLASSONION from evidence. Never represent it as a source fact.
intelligenceClasses.UNVERIFIED_INTELLIGENCE: A proposition lacking sufficient provenance or corroboration.

commandRules: Never convert an allegation into ADJUDICATED_LEGAL_FACT because it appears in a high-trust source.
Agency intelligence may establish that an agency reported or performed an action; attribution and alleged conduct retain their evidence status.
Media intelligence can supply architecture lessons, quotations, chronology signals, and corroborated context, but cannot independently establish high-impact legal or attribution conclusions.
Viewer comments and social commentary are excluded from ontology fact promotion unless independently corroborated by higher-tier intelligence.

Every promoted intelligence object must retain sourceId, source location, intelligenceTier, intelligenceClass, and a provenance locator such as page, line, timestamp, paragraph, docket entry, or section.
Analytic judgment must be visibly separated from source intelligence in every brief, query result, graph edge, and command report.
Conflicting intelligence remains represented as conflict; the system must not silently collapse competing accounts into one narrative.
Command review is required before a high-impact intelligence promotion changes attribution, legal status, identity, culpability, or external defensive action.
Virginia jurisdiction must be explicit whenever Virginia law, Virginia courts, Virginia agencies, or Virginia entities materially control the analysis.
